/standards/asme-b31-1-acceptance-criteri.fact: B31.1-2016 136.4.1: Table 136.4 sets mandatory types and extent; welds not requiring RT, UT, MT or PT acceptable on visual (136.4.2) and pressure test (para. 137); NDE for P-Nos. 3, 4, 5A, 5B and 15E after PWHT, others before or after; 136.4.2 visual per Section V Article 9, in-process examination, acceptance list (cracks, undercut 1/32 in. (1.0 mm) or encroaching on minimum wall, any undercut on longitudinal butt welds, reinforcement per Table 127.4.2, surface lack of fusion, incomplete penetration where inside surface readily accessible, linear indications over 3/16 in. (5.0 mm), surface porosity over 3/16 in. or four or more separated by 1/16 in. (2.0 mm) or less); Table 136.4 columns (over 750°F (400°C) all pressures; 350-750°F (175-400°C) with over 1,025 psig; all others), rows (butt; branch; fillet, socket, attachment, seal), thresholds (RT or UT over NPS 2, thickness over 3/4 in. (19.0 mm); branch over NPS 4; MT or PT NPS 4 and smaller), general notes (all welds visual, acceptance 136.4.2 to 136.4.6, 100% volumetric for longitudinal and spiral welds in pipe for creep-range service), notes (thicker abutting end after preparation, RT may substitute for MT or PT, branch volumetric before non-integral reinforcement, fillet welds 1/4 in. (6 mm) throat or less for non-pressure attachments exempt from MT/PT). Cell-to-column mapping taken from a scrambled extract; verify.

B31.1 visual: cracks on external surface unacceptable; undercut exceeding 1/32 in. (1.0 mm) or encroaching on minimum required section thickness unacceptable; linear indications over 3/16 in. (5.0 mm) unacceptable

B31.1 PT acceptance: crack or linear indication; rounded indications over 3/16 in. (5.0 mm); four or more in a line separated by 1/16 in. (2.0 mm) or less edge to edge; ten or more in any 6 sq in. (3 870 mm2) with major dimension not exceeding 6 in. (150 mm); Section VIII entry has no ten-in-6-sq-in criterion
B31.3 para. 341.3.4 progressive sampling: two additional samples when one fails, further steps after
B31.1 136.1 owner's inspector not an employee of manufacturer, fabricator or erector; Table 136.4 a floor raised by engineering design; boiler external piping administered under Section I
Section VIII Division 1 Appendices 6 and 8 print 1/16 in. as 1.5 mm and have no area rule

Reviewer check 2026-11-23 of the B31.1-2016 extract: 136.4.1 NDE for P-Nos. 3, 4, 5A, 5B and 15E after PWHT unless directed otherwise by engineering design; 136.4.2(A) visual list incl. (A.3) undercut on the surface of longitudinal butt welds; Table 136.4 General Note (a) visual for all welds, (f) 100% volumetric for longitudinal and spiral welds in creep-range pipe; Notes (1) thicker abutting end, (2) RT alternative to PT or MT, (3) branch volumetric before nonintegral reinforcement, (4) surface examination in lieu of volumetric for welded branch connections; Table cells scrambled in the extract (1/4 in. throat exemption note not visible there)

46 CFR 56.95-10(a): piping NDE in accordance with Table 136.4 of ASME B31.1

Reinforcement 1/16, 1/8, 5/32, 3/16 in. by thickness bands 1/4, 1/2, 1 in.; root concavity total joint thickness not below nominal of thinner component (LANL procedure attachment implementing B31.3). Table title 'Acceptance Criteria for Welds — Visual and Radiographic Examination' (search result title)

API 570 cautions that applying B31.3 workmanship radiography criteria to in-service welds may not be appropriate (existing site page)

Reviewer: Table 341.3.2 Normal and Category M girth/miter/branch: incomplete penetration <= 38 mm (1.5 in.) in any 150 mm (6 in.) or 25% of total weld length, whichever is less (no depth); rounded indications per VIII-1 Appendix 4 for Tw <= 6 mm, 1.5x for Tw > 6 mm; undercut <= 1 mm (1/32 in.) and <= Tw/4; longitudinal groove: IP and undercut zero. Severe cyclic: cracks, LOF, IP, undercut, surface porosity zero; rounded per Appendix 4; slag Tw/3, 2.5 mm (3/32 in.) and Tw/3, Tw in 12Tw; surface roughness <= 500 microin. Ra per ASME B46.1; concavity total joint >= Tw; reinforcement 1.5/3/4/5 mm by Tw bands
Reviewer: criterion E definition: Tw <= 6 mm same as D (Appendix 4); Tw > 6 mm 1.5 x D

Division 1 vessel boundary at first circumferential joint or flange face (U-1(e)); UW-12 joint efficiency drives RT extent

2020 8.26.1.5: 0.01 in. transverse to tensile stress, 1/32 in. all other cases; repair by welding under 5.7.2.2; commentary favours light grinding. 2025 8.26.1.5: 0.01 in. (transverse to primary tensile stress, tension flanges, tension zones of webs, tension-side toe of transverse fillets), 1/8 in. (corners of stiffeners and connection plates), 1/16 in. elsewhere (generally replaces 1/32 in.); toe-by-toe assessment; Commentary Fig. C-8.1. 2025 5.7.2.5: grinding to smooth surface, net section not below 98% of nominal; transverse toes 1/32 in. (<=1 in. plate) to 1/8 in. (>2 in.), 1 in. plate example; parallel/compression <=1/8 in. after grinding; weld repair 5.7.2.5(2)
